card.name: Commas and "said" in news reporting
card.fires_on: Commas after an opening time phrase, and the verb "said" or "says" after a named person, in news-style reports. The next word is usually a third-party subject or a reported claim.

modes.label: Comma after opening phrase
modes.description: A comma ends an introductory time or routine phrase before the main clause.

card.writes: It suppresses first-person words like "we" and "our", which favors third-person reporting over first-person voice.
card.plain: It marks news-style attribution, where an outside person or group is being reported on rather than "we" speaking.
